_about: HORDE-INTERIM (ROADMAP B714, ADR-410's readings; RS-2.9). Weir's manifest at the pin declares no normalised law and no mod flag; FOUNDATIONS is asked to name both (horde's brief seq 6, respond-by 2026-12-09). Until it answers, horde states them here, and this file is the swap-in point: when the manifest carries the fields, these entries are deleted and tools/rack_overlay_check.py goes red on any that remain (a manifest that declares `law` itself, redundantly or not). Every entry is horde's reading, not Weir's. cutoff is log (20 Hz to 20 kHz, the old filter_core.h position law, x = log(f/20)/log(1000)); the flip keys step; the rest lin. mod: true on the morph-class keys, false on flip keys (X114 (b): a key modulation may reach).
